subject: Scope gating & evidence staging questions for ISO/FedRAMP prep
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@northpoint-sec.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: audit-team@northpoint-sec.com
Date: 2026-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request & scoping questions for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP dry run

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the context call yesterday. As discussed, we pulled together a short starter packet to help us scope the dry run and identify gating questions up front. At a high level we need:

- Service/asset boundary confirmation (which services, regions, and environments are in-scope for FedRAMP pre-assessment vs ISO 27001)
- Snapshot window for logs and config evidence (suggest 7 consecutive days + a monthly snapshot)
- List of control owners and contactable SMEs for encryption/KMS, network segmentation, and change control
- Any third-party attestations (hosting, KMS, monitoring) you intend to rely on

Attached: Request_Package_2026Q4.pdf (PDF, 420 KB) — includes a suggested evidence inventory template and sample extraction queries.

Can you confirm whether the following are accurate for Redwood Inference?
1) Primary FedRAMP-targeted boundary: hosted API + dedicated pools (us-west-2 region)
2) ISO scope: platform control plane + runtime telemetry, excluding developer self-serve sandboxes
3) KMS: customer-managed keys for Private deployments only; hosted uses Redwood KMS (Y/N)

If you can reply with owners and a preferred snapshot window by COB Tuesday we can draft an intake and a short dry-run plan.

Best,
Elena
Senior Manager, Compliance Services
NorthPoint Security

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@northpoint-sec.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request & scoping questions for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP dry run

Elena — thanks for the packet and clear checklist. Quick responses inline below, and a proposed next step.

1) Primary FedRAMP-targeted boundary: hosted API + Dedicated pools in us-west-2 — yes, that is our preferred initial boundary. We want to exclude Private (VPC) customers from the FedRAMP scope for now.
2) ISO scope: platform control plane + runtime telemetry — correct; developer sandboxes and internal staging clusters are out of scope unless requested by a customer-specific assessment.
3) KMS: hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS; Private customers may provide customer-managed keys (we will provide attestation artifacts for both cases).

Proposed snapshot window: Oct 18–24, 2026 (7 days) with a monthly config snapshot on Oct 1. We can run extraction scripts during a low-traffic window (overnight UTC).

Owners (primary):
- Encryption/KMS: Markus Klein (markus_klein@redwood.ai)
- Network segmentation & VPC boundaries: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.ai)
- Change control & release evidence: Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.ai)

I attached an evidence_matrix_draft.xlsx with preliminary mapping to the Request_Package. We still need to confirm log retention windows and the snapshot access method for Dedicated pools.

Next step: can we book a 30-min session with Markus and Monica for Monday (Oct 12) to review extraction queries and narrow required artifacts? If that works, I’ll share a calendar invite and the extraction scripts we plan to run.

Thanks — Irene
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attached: evidence_matrix_draft.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@northpoint-sec.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request & scoping questions for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP dry run

Thanks Irene / Elena — I can take the KMS artifacts and help validate the key rotation logs and access reports. A couple of operational clarifications from my side before the Monday call:

- For Hosted KMS: do you need Cloud KMS audit logs or an exported key usage report? We can provide both but the extraction path differs.
- For Dedicated pools: extraction will require brief elevated access; suggest we do a scripted, read-only pull and share the output over the secure drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bEvidenceStaging).
- Do you have a preference for redaction guidance (PII, customer identifiers) on snapshots? We prefer to redact customer-managed identifiers but keep system-level IDs intact for traceability.

I’m available Mon Oct 12 at 10:00 PT for the call.

-Markus
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@northpoint-sec.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request & scoping questions for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP dry run

Elena — great, Monday 10:00 PT works and we’ll prepare the items below for the dry run snapshot window Oct 18–24:

Action items before the call (owners):
- Markus: generate hosted KMS audit log export examples and sample key-rotation proof (due Oct 13 COB)
- Monica: confirm network boundary diagrams and provide CIDR lists for Dedicated pools (due Oct 13 COB)
- Grace: draft change control ticket examples and release notes mapping (due Oct 14 COB)
- Irene: finalize evidence_matrix_draft.xlsx with column for redaction guidance + upload to shared drive (done by Oct 13 morning)

Elena — if you can confirm the exact list of extraction queries you want us to run (or point to the section in Request_Package_2026Q4.pdf), we’ll prioritize those. Also, please confirm whether the auditor team needs a pre-signed S3 link or the secure drive transfer for the snapshot outputs.

Talk Monday — thanks,
Irene
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
